007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.EmailNotificationToolParams;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.GenericToolParams;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RagToolParams;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.SlackNotificationToolParams;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.SqlToolParams;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolParams;
016import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolType;
017import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.WebSearchToolParams;
018
019import java.util.Map;
020
021/**
022 * Builds typed tool parameters and prints their database attribute JSON.
023 *
024 * <p>No database connection or environment variables are required. This sample
025 * does not create resources or call tools. Profile and credential names are
026 * illustrative; the database validates them when creating or updating a tool.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>Pass the resulting {@link ToolAttributes} to
029 * {@link com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent#tool(String, ToolAttributes,
030 * String, com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolStatus)} for creation,
031 * or to {@link com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool#setAttributes(ToolAttributes)}
032 * for an update. See {@link CreateSqlToolSample} and
033 * {@link SetSqlToolParamsSample} for database-backed examples.</p>
034 *
035 * <p>The future parameter names below are illustrative, not claims that a
036 * particular database release supports them. They are never submitted to a
037 * database. Only the literal, non-sensitive example values are printed.</p>
038 */
039public final class ToolParamsSample {
040    private ToolParamsSample() {
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * Prints configurations for the supported parameter models.
045     *
046     * @param args unused command-line arguments
047     */
048    public static void main(String[] args) {
049        SqlToolParams sql = SqlToolParams.builder().profileName("NL2SQL_PROFILE").build();
050        print(ToolType.SQL, sql);
051        print(ToolType.RAG, RagToolParams.builder().profileName("RAG_PROFILE").build());
052        print(ToolType.WEBSEARCH, WebSearchToolParams.builder()
053                .credentialName("WEBSEARCH_CRED").build());
054        print(ToolType.NOTIFICATION, SlackNotificationToolParams.builder()
055                .credentialName("SLACK_CRED").channel("support").build());
056        print(ToolType.NOTIFICATION, EmailNotificationToolParams.builder()
057                .credentialName("EMAIL_CRED").recipient("recipient@example.com")
058                .sender("sender@example.com").smtpHost("smtp.example.com")
059                .subject("Support update").build());
060
061        // The generic form preserves parameters introduced by newer databases.
062        ToolParams future = GenericToolParams.builder()
063                .parameter("future_options", Map.of("mode", "example"))
064                .build();
065        print(ToolType.of("FUTURE_TOOL"), future);
066
067        // Adapt an existing map without losing database-defined fields.
068        GenericToolParams generic = GenericToolParams.fromMap(
069                Map.of("profile_name", "NL2SQL_PROFILE", "future_options", Map.of("enabled", true)));
070        print(ToolType.SQL, generic);
071
072        // Known models also accept additional parameters for newer databases.
073        SqlToolParams extended = SqlToolParams.builder()
074                .profileName("NL2SQL_PROFILE")
075                .additionalParameter("future_options", Map.of("enabled", true))
076                .build();
077        print(ToolType.SQL, extended);
078
079        ToolParams loaded = ToolParams.fromMap(ToolType.SQL, sql.toMap());
080        if (loaded instanceof SqlToolParams loadedSql) {
081            System.out.println("SQL profile: " + loadedSql.getProfileName());
082        }
083
084        ToolParams unknown = ToolParams.fromMap(ToolType.of("FUTURE_TOOL"), future.toMap());
085        System.out.println("Unknown tool parameter model: " + unknown.getClass().getSimpleName());
086    }
087
088    private static void print(ToolType toolType, ToolParams params) {
089        System.out.println(ToolAttributes.builder().toolType(toolType).toolParams(params).build().toJson());
090        System.out.println("Parameter names: " + params.toMap().keySet());
091        if (params instanceof SqlToolParams sql) {
092            System.out.println("SQL profile: " + sql.getProfileName());
093        } else if (params instanceof RagToolParams rag) {
094            System.out.println("RAG profile: " + rag.getProfileName());
095        } else if (params instanceof WebSearchToolParams webSearch) {
096            System.out.println("Web-search credential: " + webSearch.getCredentialName());
097        } else if (params instanceof SlackNotificationToolParams slack) {
098            System.out.printf("Notification: %s; credential: %s; channel: %s%n",
099                    slack.getNotificationType(), slack.getCredentialName(), slack.getChannel());
100        } else if (params instanceof EmailNotificationToolParams email) {
101            System.out.printf("Notification: %s; credential: %s; recipient: %s; sender: %s; SMTP: %s; subject: %s%n",
102                    email.getNotificationType(), email.getCredentialName(), email.getRecipient(),
103                    email.getSender(), email.getSmtpHost(), email.getSubject());
104        }
105    }
106}
